Planning & pricing

How do I get a shipping quote?+

Use our quote form to share your goods, quantity, approximate weight or dimensions, shipping method, and destination. It prepares a WhatsApp message for you to review and send. Our team confirms the charges after reviewing your shipment.

Should I choose sea shipping or air freight?+

Sea shipping is generally a practical option for larger cargo when timing is flexible. Air freight is worth discussing when timing matters more. Availability, suitability, cost, and expected timing are confirmed for your specific goods.

How much will my shipment cost?+

There is no published flat rate on this website. Tell us what you are sending and provide weight and package dimensions if available. Ask the team to confirm the charging basis, what is included, and any additional charges before booking.

How long will delivery take?+

Ask the team for the current estimate for your shipment before you book. Timing depends on the shipping method, departure schedule, cargo checks, and arrival arrangements. We do not promise an unconfirmed arrival date.

Does submitting a quote book my shipment?+

No. The form helps you prepare an enquiry. You still need to send the message in WhatsApp and agree the shipping details and charges with our team.

Preparing your cargo

Where do I send my goods in China?+

Contact the China team before dispatch. The Guangzhou address listed on our locations page is for the sea warehouse. For air freight, request the correct receiving instructions separately.

How should my supplier label the packages?+

Write the customer’s name, phone number, and destination city clearly on the outside of every package. Confirm any additional shipping mark with the receiving team before dispatch.

Can I ship batteries, liquids, or fragile goods?+

Tell the team exactly what the goods contain before sending them. Batteries, liquids, chemicals, fragile items, and other special cargo need a suitability check and may require specific handling. A quote request is not confirmation that an item is accepted.

What are the China sea warehouse receiving hours?+

The supplied receiving hours are Monday to Saturday, 8:30–12:00 and 13:30–18:00, China time. Check with the China team before dispatch, especially around holidays.

Updates & collection

How do I get a shipment update?+

Contact the team handling your shipment and share your customer name, shipment reference if provided, goods description, and the date you handed over your cargo. Updates are currently handled directly by our team.

Where can I collect my goods in Nigeria?+

We have offices in Lagos Island and Onitsha. Confirm your collection location and arrangements with the team before booking. For other cities, ask what options are available.

How do I pay for shipping?+

Request an invoice and payment instructions directly from the company. Confirm the shipment details, charges, and payment recipient with your Bright Ocean contact before making payment.
